description: This file defines the EmbeddedDataSource class for Drupal's migrate module, which provides a source plugin that injects fixed, configuration-defined data for migration purposes, including methods for data handling, iteration, and identification.

classes.name: EmbeddedDataSource
classes.description: A Drupal migration source plugin class that provides embedded, configuration-defined data for migration processes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dataRows and ids properties from configuration and calls parent constructor.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns the list of field names based on the first data row.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the dataRows array.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the source, 'Embedded data'.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the array of ID fields for the source data.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of data rows; overrides to avoid cacheable count.
